approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Design a polished vertical event story graphic for ROOFTOP JAZZ. Restrained vintage jazz-club graphic design, warm cream paper background (#F4E9D5), deep burgundy ink (#651D32), two-color screenprint texture. Strong elegant oversized condensed serif headline at top reading exactly 'ROOFTOP JAZZ'. Central graphic: stylized burgundy saxophone with a sweeping ribbon-like curve, small rooftop skyline and a cream moon inside a burgundy circular medallion. Refined art deco thin double-rule border, generous negative space, editorial hierarchy, stylish and legible rather than busy. Lower area contains these four exact event details on separate well-spaced lines in large clean high-contrast type: '17 October 2027' / '7 PM' / 'Atlas Roof' / 'Free entry'. No other words, no logos, no watermark. Keep every letter sharp and correctly spelled. All text and key design elements inside generous story-safe margins, particularly at top and bottom. This is the master artwork of a coordinated cream-and-burgundy jazz promotion campaign.
